packages.title: Tirupati Local Temple Tour
packages.summary: The main temples in and around Tirupati in one comfortable day.
packages.overview: A full day visiting the temples in Tirupati and nearby Tiruchanur. Your driver plans the order around opening times and crowds, waits at each stop, and drops you back at your hotel or station in the evening. Temple entry and darshan tickets are not included; you can buy them at the temples or online.

faqs.q: What time does the tour start?
faqs.a: Usually between 6 and 7 AM. Your driver confirms the time the evening before.

faqs.q: Can we change the order of temples or add a stop?
faqs.a: Yes. Mention it in your booking request or tell the driver on the day. Extra time or distance may be charged.

packages.title: Tirupati to Tirumala Transport
packages.summary: A safe ride up the ghat road to Tirumala, one-way or return.
packages.overview: Pickup from your hotel, the railway station or the airport, and a drive up the ghat road to Tirumala. All vehicles stop at the Alipiri checkpoint for TTD's security check. For a return trip, the driver waits or comes back at the agreed time. This is a transport service only: book your darshan tickets separately through TTD.

faqs.q: Can the driver wait while we have darshan?

packages.title: Kanipakam & Srikalahasti Tour
packages.summary: Sri Varasiddhi Vinayaka Temple at Kanipakam and Srikalahasti Temple in one day.
packages.overview: A full-day trip from Tirupati to two of the region's best-known temples: Sri Varasiddhi Vinayaka Swamy Temple at Kanipakam and Sri Kalahasteeswara Swamy Temple at Srikalahasti. The driver plans the route around temple timings, and you return to Tirupati in the evening.

packages.title: Vellore Golden Temple Tour
packages.summary: Day trip to Sri Lakshmi Narayani Golden Temple at Sripuram, Vellore.
packages.overview: A day trip across the state border to the Sri Lakshmi Narayani Golden Temple at Sripuram, Vellore, about 120 km from Tirupati. There's an optional stop at Vellore Fort if time allows. Tamil Nadu interstate permit charges may apply.

faqs.q: Are there rules for visitors at Sripuram?
faqs.a: The temple has its own dress and security rules, including restrictions on phones. Please check them before you travel.

packages.title: Airport & Railway Station Transfers
packages.summary: Pickups and drops at Tirupati Airport, Tirupati station and Renigunta Junction.
packages.overview: Your driver tracks your train or flight and meets you on arrival. Transfers run to and from anywhere in Tirupati, or straight up to Tirumala.

faqs.q: What if my train is late?
faqs.a: Share your train or flight number when you book, and the driver will adjust to your actual arrival time.

packages.title: Local Cab Booking
packages.summary: A cab with driver by the hour, for errands and visits around Tirupati.
packages.overview: Hire a cab with a driver for a half day or a full day around Tirupati. Use it for shopping, hospital visits, or temples you want to visit at your own pace.
packages.priceUnit: per package; extra km and hours charged
